items.title: Late Gakpo strike denies Klopp winning start with Germany
items.description: Cody Gakpo hit a stoppage-time volley to earn the Netherlands a 1-1 draw against Germany in their Nations League Group A2 opener on Thursday, denying Jurgen Klopp victory in his first match as Germany boss.

items.title: Man Utd borrow another £90m as debt tops £1.1bn
items.description: Manchester United confirm they have borrowed another £90m since 30 June, to take their overall debt to more than £1.1bn.

items.title: Uefa fears impact of Premier League spending on transfer market
items.description: Uefa believes "a clear two-speed system" is emerging in the transfer market due to huge spending by Premier League clubs this summer.

items.title: 'Don't put pressure on us' over Israel games - Ogbene
items.description: Republic of Ireland winger Chiedozie Ogbene urges the public to not "put the pressure on us" over the campaign to boycott the upcoming Nations League games against Israel.
